title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1972-08-22

ai_review.summary: High‑energy ’72 show shines with a smoking “Other One” and scorching GDTRFB solo, captured on a solid soundboard mix that improves after the first few minutes.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the incendiary second set – especially The Other One’s bass frenzy and an unforgettable Goin’ Down the Road Feeling Bad solo that some even call "bezerk." The soundboard recording is generally clear, though listeners note the mix gets noticeably better around the eight‑minute mark, resulting in a very listenable document of a classic ’70s performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and enthusiastic comments about the music; recording is solid with minor early‑mix issues, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear soundboard capture; mix is a bit thin in the opening ~8 minutes but improves markedly for the rest of the show. No major drop‑outs reported.

standout_songs: Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight opening with Truckin', a soaring jam on Tennessee Jed, then a monster second set highlighted by The Other One and GDTRFB; the energy builds steadily throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise his raw, bezerk solo on GDTRFB (some wonder if it's Jerry or another), though he forgets lyrics briefly on Stella Blue.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lauded as a "sonic‑assassin" with a devastating bass solo on The Other One that propels the jam and creates a near‑transcendent experience.
